# Coffee and Cashew Nut Dataset (cashew part)

- Dataset id in this project: `cashew_makerere`
- Page: https://data.mendeley.com/datasets/r46c6bpfpf/1
- DOI: https://doi.org/10.17632/r46c6bpfpf.1
- Version: Mendeley Data version 1 (published 2023-11-10)
- Authors: Joyce Nakatumba-Nabende, Andrew Katumba, Rahman Sanya, Jeremy Tusubira, Sudi Murindanyi, Gloria Namanya, Ann Nabiryo (Makerere University, Uganda)
- Setting: field photos of cashew trees taken from a drone at close range; not a conveyor belt
- Fruit: cashew apple
- Licence: [CC BY 4.0](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/)
- Licence as written on the source: Mendeley Data licence field on version 1: CC BY 4.0 (Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International)
- Commercial use: allowed with attribution
